The change itself is fine I think, but it should probably be done behind an option

Actually the problems lies in prettier (it's actually the check that fails) and parenthesis seems very troublesome as a problem (https://github.com/prettier/prettier/issues/187).

@rezak-otmani can you find a way to rewrite that code so that it doesn't rely on parenthesis (like introducing an intermediate variable that holds the result of parseFloat)?

Prettier 1.13 might fix the calculation issue: [Insert more parentheses in math expressions](https://prettier.io/blog/2018/05/27/1.13.0.html#insert-more-parentheses-in-math-expressions-4413-and-4407-by-duailibe).
I changed the base branch so that we can apply changes to your fix. Thank you @rezak-otmani!
